title: Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Substance Use in Adolescents in Three Independent Worldwide Cohorts: Algorithm Development and Validation Study.
authors: Kim S, Kim H, Kim S, Lee H, Hammoodi A, Choi Y, Kim HJ, Smith L, Kim MS, Fond G, Boyer L, Baik SW, Lee H, Park J, Kwon R, Woo S, Yon DK.

Model architecture. The original KYRBS was partitioned into the original data set for model development, with performance assessed using the AUROC score.
